steps.title: The mysterious archaeologist
steps.text: Talk to Ali the Wise in the northernmost building in Nardah.

actions.text: How goes the research?
Well, I certainly don't like those of the Zamorakian faction.
Zaros seems to be an honourable god.

steps.text: [Accept Quest]

actions.text: Can you help me get to the Digsite Exam Centre?

steps.text:
Go to the Exam Centre.
  • If you asked Ali for help getting there, he gave you a Dig Site pendant (or Ali's pendant if you have not unlocked the ability to create Dig Site pendants) to teleport directly there.
  • Alternatively, teleporting to Varrock Dig Site with either pendant for the first time will grant you the Return to Senntisten achievement.
Talk to Dr. Nabanik outside of the Exam Centre south of the Digsite.

actions.text: (Whisper) Why are we speaking so quietly?
Azzanadra? You are quite the master of disguise.
Why are you here, away from the pyramid?
What's Ali's part in this?
Why all the secrecy?
Just tell me what you want.

postconditions.text: I wish for your aid in getting a restoration certificate, which will grant me permission to perform some restorations to the temple beneath these ruins.

steps.text: Talk to Terry Balando inside the exam centre for a restoration certificate.

actions.text: I'm here about a close friend of mine: Dr Nabanik.
He was in the pyramid for a very long time.
I've seen those beetles and they're huge.
He studies pyramids, particularly their interiors.
He has an aged benefactor.

postconditions.text: This benefactor is not likely to die and leave Nabanik suddenly poor, I trust?

steps.text: Talk to Dr. Nabanik. He will give you a rope.
Use the rope on the winch in the north-east dig site, north of The Stormbreaker ship.
Operate the winch to enter the Digsite dungeon.
Talk to Azzanadra in the southern part of the dungeon.

actions.text: I'd like to talk about the temple.
Is there anything I can do to help?
Okay, what do I need to do?
Tell me about the mission in the north.
[Any option]

steps.text: Open the ruined backpack for a battered letter and heat globe.
Read the letter and then talk to Azzanadra.

actions.text: I'd like to talk about the temple.
Tell me about the mission in Morytania.
I have some questions about the mission in Morytania.
Do you have any advice for me?
Let's talk about something else.
Tell me about the artefacts you need.
Tell me about the fortress artefact.
Tell me about the Barrows artefact.
Never mind.

steps.title: Barrows icon
steps.text: Travel to the Barrows.

Kill the six Barrows Brothers found in their tombs below the ground.
  • Barrows amulets can be used to skip killing up to three brothers.
  • Amulets can only be used on the tombs before the brother is summoned.
  • The final brother must be killed without using an amulet.
Once all six brothers are dead, search the chest at the centre of the tunnels beneath the crypts to get the Barrows icon.

steps.title: Frostenhorn
steps.text:
Go to the Ghorrock fortress:
  • First use the canoe near Erjolf from Tale of the Muspah for a quick access. It is located on the west coast of the Rellekka Hunter area, north of fairy ring code DKS.
  • Go east and place the heat globe on the pedestal near the ice block entrance.
  • Squeeze past the ice block.
Enter the fortress through the south entrance and climb-up the stairs to the west.
Run to the south-east corner of the castle and climb-down the stairs east.
Scale up the damaged wall north of the door.
Climb down the smashed rampart in the north-west corner.
Enter the trapdoor in front of you.

steps.title: Upper level
steps.text: Run east and take the heat globe.

Return to the entrance room of the basement, and place the heat globe on the pedestal on the west side.
  • A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.
Go inside the west room, then right-click the radiant pedestal to cast Telekinetic Grab on it.

Use the globe on this room's pedestal. Go down the trapdoor.
  • A waterfiend will be released. It is immune to fire damage, but does not need to be killed.

steps.title: Lower level
steps.text: Pick up the globe in the southern room.
Use it on the pedestal back in the northern room with the ladder. 2 waterfiends will spawn.
Loot the crates in the south room for 40 law runes and 300 air runes.
Go to the east room and take the globe from the pedestal for an imperfect heat globe.
Exit the dungeon the way you entered.

steps.title: Surface
steps.text: Scale the damaged wall to the west, then head to the north-east corner to the destroyed pedestal.
Insert-globe in the smashed globe-holder.
Choose the push option on the smashed pedestal on the ground.
Return to the dungeon by re-entering the trapdoor.

actions.text: Yes, carry on from where I was.

steps.title: Lower level
steps.text: Go down the trapdoor in the western room.
Run through the dungeon and take the heat globe from the pedestal in the southwestern corner.
Head back east through the hallway you ran through until you reach the southeast corner, where the path turns north.
At that corner, look for a pipe on the south wall.
Choose the 'Place-globe' option on the pipe.
Choose the 'Whack' option on the pipe.
Continue into the southeastern room and climb the ladder to go up.

steps.title: Upper level
steps.text: Head west and kill the ice demon (it cannot be damaged by water spells).
Take the Frostenhorn that it drops.

steps.title: The big bang
steps.text:
Return to Azzanadra with the items back at the Senntisten Temple underneath the Dig Site.
  • The Dig Site pendant can be used to teleport outside the temple (option 2).

actions.text: I'd like to talk about the temple.
I have something here for you.
What does the Frosthorn do?
Okay, what do I need to obtain next?

postconditions.text: Fear not, there is no more gathering of items for you. Another of my illustrious contacts is making their way here with the final item.

steps.text: Back outside near the winch, talk to the Assassin for a relic.

actions.text: Mask or no mask, I remember you.
[Any option]
[Any option]
[Any option]

steps.text: Return to Azzanadra.

actions.text: I'd like to talk about the temple.
Anyway, what now?
I'm not interested, I just want a reward
Boring! Get on with it!

postconditions.text: Hold thy tongue, Player! I will not have you ruin centuries of planning!

steps.text: After the cutscene, speak to Azzanadra again.

actions.text: I'm glad I could help.
[Any option]

steps.text: Quest complete!
